subject: A compact pottery wheel with a round pale terracotta bowl being shaped on its turntable; simple muted teal base, just the wheel and attached bowl, no hands or person.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE new individual PNG sticker for a casual mobile sorting game.
The attached original desktop Stickers images are strict style references only, not subjects to copy. Match the same illustrator's visual language and restrained contrast.
SUBJECT is supplied below. Depict only that cohesive object or character and its necessary connected parts. Make the subject immediately recognizable at small size, with a clear simple silhouette.
Hand-painted 2D casual-game illustration: matte color blocks, thin softly irregular tinted contours derived from each local material, finer and lighter internal lines, gently rounded proportions.
